comments.regular: Renderer accumulation debug replay/freeze flag. Sole writer is ToggleRendererAccumulationFrozen through the registered FreezeRenderAccumulation/fra console command. When set, FlushPassBucket draws but retains active selector-bucket nodes; accumulator flush preserves replay state, and ShadowSceneNode skips the render-mode-5 active-shadow-light loop. This is not an ordinary frame-lifecycle flag.
